bills.title: Foreign agent registration, foreign terrorist organizations, and foreign adversaries.
Ban on employer use of automated decision systems.
Civil liability for child sexual abuse material.
Various mental health and insurance matters.

reading.body:
Indiana's most directly AI-relevant legislation in this set is HB1421, which would ban employer use of automated decision systems, while the majority of the other ten bills address healthcare, foreign adversary concerns, and digital image abuse.

The eleven bills span from December 2025 through March 2026. Only a handful touch AI clearly. HB1421 targets automated decision systems in employment. HB1085, HB1182, and HB1183 address civil liability and criminal exposure for digitally generated sexual imagery, a category where AI-generated content is the evident concern. The foreign adversary bills, SB0256 and HB1099, may implicate AI supply chains or technology sourcing, but their titles do not confirm that.

The healthcare bills, SB0180, HB1271, SB0173, and HB1201, along with the utility bill SB0083, carry no AI signal in their titles. SB0083 is the only bill here that could touch power infrastructure, which is the resource layer most constraining to AI deployment, but the data provides no detail on its contents. The record covers bills tagged to Indiana through August 2026 and does not indicate which passed, failed, or remain active.
